zh-CN.title: ChromiumPortable 便携版构建向导
zh-CN.tagline: 只做解包与 Chrome++ 注入，不安装、不启动浏览器。
zh-CN.output_hint: 产物一般在 build\release\，打包后在 build\assets\。
zh-CN.action_one: 构建单个安装包（本机已有文件）
zh-CN.action_folder: 构建文件夹里的全部安装包
zh-CN.action_online: 在线下载最新安装包并构建
zh-CN.ask_folder: 安装包文件夹（回车使用上面的目录）
zh-CN.empty_folder_2: 请把浏览器安装包（.exe / .msi / .7z 等）复制到该目录后重新运行，
zh-CN.empty_folder_3: 或在下面输入其它文件夹路径 / 安装包完整路径。
zh-CN.empty_folder_4: 目录里附有 README.txt 说明。
zh-CN.about_to_folder: 即将构建 {count} 个安装包（{arch}）
zh-CN.choose_online: 请选择要下载构建的浏览器：
zh-CN.done_eula: 请自行评估上游 EULA；本构建非官方发行。
zh-CN.failed: 失败，退出码 {code}。请把上方错误信息发给维护者。
zh-CN.hint_token: 提示：GitHub 限流可设置环境变量 GITHUB_TOKEN 后重试；
zh-CN.hint_local: Helium 等若无公开安装包，请改用「构建单个安装包」自备文件。
zh-CN.eof_error: 没有读到输入（请在普通终端/双击窗口里运行，而不是被管道重定向）。
zh-CN.online_helium: Helium（若无公开包请自备安装包）
zh-CN.gui_subtitle: 静态解包 + Chrome++ 注入，不安装、不启动浏览器
zh-CN.gui_page_build_desc: 把安装包变成可随身携带的浏览器文件夹：解包 → 注入 Chrome++ → 可选打包。
zh-CN.gui_page_tools_desc: 这些命令各自独立运行，不写入 release 目录，结果同样进下方日志。
zh-CN.gui_mode_one: 用本机已有的安装包：解包 → 定位主程序 → 注入 Chrome++。
zh-CN.gui_mode_folder: 把一个文件夹里的安装包逐个构建，每个都独立出产物。
zh-CN.gui_mode_online: 按目录表取该目标的最新安装包再构建。
zh-CN.gui_installer_empty_body: 把 .exe / .msi / .7z / .zip / .rar / .cab 放进工作目录的 installers\ 文件夹。
zh-CN.gui_folder_hint: 目录里每个安装包各自出一份产物，互不影响。
zh-CN.gui_target_hint: 目标来自目录表（catalog/browser_catalog.json），由上游提供安装包。
zh-CN.gui_url_hint: 可选。仅当所选目标没有公开安装包、或你要指定具体版本时填写。
zh-CN.gui_local_hint: 可选。自己准备的安装包，优先于直链。
zh-CN.gui_archive_hint: 打包成 7z 并做一次静态校验；关掉就只留 build\release 里的解包目录。
zh-CN.gui_workdir_hint: 安装包目录、build\ 与 7zr.exe 都放在这里，默认是本程序所在目录。
zh-CN.gui_output_hint: 解包后的目录在 build\release\，7z 分发包在 build\assets\。
zh-CN.gui_rail_hint: 按当前选择会执行的步骤
zh-CN.gui_log_empty: 构建日志会实时显示在这里。
zh-CN.gui_tool_path_hint: 识别安装包用文件路径，批量巡检用文件夹路径。
zh-CN.gui_token_hint: 可选。只有「解析上游下载地址」在遭遇 GitHub 限流时才需要它。
zh-CN.gui_tools_commands_hint: 每个工具独立运行，结果写进下方日志，不产出便携目录。
zh-CN.gui_tool_inspect_hint: 不运行安装包，直接解析结构并定位主程序。
zh-CN.gui_tool_research_hint: 对文件夹里所有安装包各做一次结构识别。
zh-CN.gui_tool_resolve_hint: 抓取所选目标最新安装包的直链与校验值。
zh-CN.gui_tool_chplus: 更新 Chrome++ 注入资源
zh-CN.gui_tool_chplus_hint: 从 Bush2021/chrome_plus 同步 setdll/ 下的基线文件。
zh-CN.gui_tool_verify_hint: 按所选目标校验 build/selected.browser.json 对应的产物。
zh-CN.gui_need_path: 这个工具需要先选择安装包或文件夹。
zh-CN.gui_busy: 已有任务在运行，请等它结束或先取消。
zh-CN.gui_confirm_exit: 任务还在运行，确定退出吗？
zh-CN.gui_step_build_folder: 构建文件夹里的全部安装包
zh-CN.gui_section_more_hint: 架构与打包，不改也能用

en.title: ChromiumPortable portable build wizard
en.tagline: Extract and inject Chrome++ only — never installs or launches a browser.
en.output_hint: Output is usually build\release\; archives go to build\assets\.
en.action_one: Build one installer (file already on this PC)
en.action_folder: Build every installer in a folder
en.action_online: Download latest installer online and build
en.empty_folder_2: Copy browser installers (.exe / .msi / .7z …) there and run again,
en.empty_folder_3: or type another folder / full installer path below.
en.choose_online: Choose a browser to download and build:
en.done_eula: Review the upstream EULA yourself; this build is unofficial.
en.failed: Failed with exit code {code}. Please share the log above.
en.hint_token: Tip: set GITHUB_TOKEN if GitHub rate-limits you;
en.hint_local: For Helium etc. without public installers, use “Build one installer”.
en.eof_error: No input (run in a real terminal / double-click window, not a pipe).
en.online_helium: Helium (bring your own installer if needed)
en.gui_subtitle: Static extract + Chrome++ injection — no install, no launch
en.gui_page_build_desc: Turn an installer into a browser folder you can carry around: extract, inject Chrome++, optionally package.
en.gui_page_tools_desc: These commands run on their own, write nothing to the release folder, and log below.
en.gui_mode_one: Use an installer already on this PC: extract, locate the main exe, inject Chrome++.
en.gui_mode_folder: Build every installer in a folder, each producing its own output.
en.gui_mode_online: Fetch the newest installer for the selected catalog target, then build it.
en.gui_installer_empty_body: Drop .exe / .msi / .7z / .zip / .rar / .cab into the workdir's installers\ folder.
en.gui_installer_path: Or point at a file directly
en.gui_folder_hint: Every installer in the folder produces its own output.
en.gui_target_hint: Targets come from the catalog (catalog/browser_catalog.json); upstream supplies the installer.
en.gui_url_hint: Optional. Only when the target has no public installer, or you need a specific build.
en.gui_local_hint: Optional. A package you already have; it wins over the URL.
en.gui_archive_hint: Writes a 7z package and runs one static verify pass; off keeps only the unpacked folder in build\release.
en.gui_workdir_hint: Holds the installers folder, build\ and 7zr.exe; defaults to the program's own folder.
en.gui_output_hint: Unpacked builds go to build\release\, 7z packages to build\assets\.
en.gui_rail_hint: Steps that will run for the current selection
en.gui_log_empty: Build output streams here in real time.
en.gui_tool_path_hint: Inspect wants a file; batch research wants a folder.
en.gui_token_hint: Optional. Only “Resolve upstream URL” needs it, and only when GitHub rate-limits you.
en.gui_tools_commands_hint: Each tool runs on its own, logs below, and produces no portable folder.
en.gui_tool_inspect_hint: Parse the package without running it and locate its main executable.
en.gui_tool_research_hint: Identify every installer in a folder in one pass.
en.gui_tool_prepare_hint: Writes build/selected.browser.json for the selected target.
en.gui_tool_resolve_hint: Fetch the latest installer URL and digest for the selected target.
en.gui_tool_chplus_hint: Sync the setdll/ baseline from Bush2021/chrome_plus.
en.gui_tool_verify_hint: Verify the artifact described by build/selected.browser.json.
en.gui_need_path: This tool needs an installer or folder path first.
en.gui_busy: A task is already running — wait for it or cancel it first.
en.gui_confirm_exit: A task is still running. Quit anyway?
en.gui_step_build_folder: Build every installer in the folder
en.gui_section_more_hint: Architecture and packaging — defaults are fine
